capabilities: Index checkbox lines with due dates, recurrence and goals into a task panel
Group, reorder, multi-select and batch-edit tasks in a sidebar
Reschedule tasks on month, week, day, quarter and year calendar views
Show a dashboard with activity heatmap, check-ins, goal streaks and progress trends
Embed filtered task views in notes with tasks query blocks
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; AI planning requires installing the separate AI Host plugin, and the UI ships in Chinese.
intentEvidence: Taskdown turns plain Markdown checkbox lines into a live task panel in Obsidian
problem: Obsidian checkbox lists have no aggregated view, so managing due dates, recurrence and progress across a vault means scanning notes manually.

relations.evidence: With the companion AI Host plugin, turn a sentence, a recording or selected notes into task drafts
A task is a line in a note, in the familiar Tasks style

summary: Task panel that turns Markdown checkbox lines with due dates, recurrence and goals into a grouped board with calendar, heatmap and dashboard.
